# Which of your Poshmark items and brands actually make money?

> Free analyzer for Poshmark sellers: load your My Sales Report CSV and see profit per item, brand and month after Poshmark's $2.95 / 20% fee, with effective fee rate, cost basis by SKU, shipping losses, days to sell and brands to stop sourcing. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
